resources.string: Keep the keyboard open when sending messages
After sending a message, continue typing without reopening the braille keyboard.
Capitalize all sentences and text after a period
First letter when activating the keyboard and after a period and space will be capitalized unless deleted.
Tap each of the 6 dots on the screen to recalibrate the keyboard.
Dot recalibration. Touch the screen at the position for dot 1.
Learn how to type, navigate, use gestures, recalibrate dots, lock orientation, and more.
Practice step-by-step how to type letters, gestures, and use the Braille keyboard.
Tap here to practice typing and gestures with the Braille keyboard...
Practice text area. Tap to open the Braille keyboard.

• Screen-away mode: Hold the device with the screen facing outward (away from you). Grasp both sides with your hands. Your left index, middle, and ring fingers rest on dots 1, 2, and 3; your right index, middle, and ring fingers rest on dots 4, 5, and 6.\n• Tabletop mode: Place the phone flat on a table or desk. Position your hands over the screen with dots arranged naturally under your fingertips.

• Type letters: Tap dot combinations simultaneously.
• Space: Swipe 1 finger to the right.
• Delete character (Backspace): Swipe 1 finger to the left.
• New line (Enter): Swipe 2 fingers to the right.
• Delete whole word: Swipe 2 fingers to the left.

The legacy TalkBack two-step calibration has been replaced with dot-by-dot sequential calibration.
• Tap the "Recalibrate dots now" button above or select "Dot recalibration" from Settings or the Options menu.
• The voice prompt will guide you to tap dot 1, then dot 2, through dot 6 where your fingers comfortably rest.
• Each tap produces a confirmation beep and vibration, saving your custom layout immediately.

Prevents the Braille dots from rotating unexpectedly when tilting or moving your phone.\n• Gesture: Hold dots 4, 5, and 6 and swipe UP with 1 finger.\n• Speech feedback will confirm whether the orientation is locked or unlocked.

• Enter / Exit emoji mode: Hold dots 4, 5, and 6 and swipe RIGHT with 1 finger.\n• Navigate emojis: Use Braille letters A through J or symbols (*, #, $) to choose categories, K through Z for rows, or swipe up and down to explore and insert emojis.
• Quick dictation: Hold dots 4, 5, and 6 and swipe DOWN with 1 finger.\n• Speak your message, and it will be transcribed directly into the active field.

• Move by character: Swipe 1 finger UP (previous) or DOWN (next).
• Move by word: Hold dot 5 and swipe 1 finger UP (previous word) or DOWN (next word).
• Move by line: Hold dot 4 and swipe 1 finger UP (previous line) or DOWN (next line).
• Jump to start / end of text: Hold dots 4 and 5 and swipe 1 finger UP (start) or DOWN (end).
• Change navigation granularity: Swipe 3 fingers LEFT or RIGHT.
8. Clipboard: Copy, Cut, Paste, and Select All

• Select all text: Hold dot 4 and swipe 3 fingers to the LEFT.
• Cut text: Hold dot 4 and swipe 3 fingers UP.
• Copy text: Hold dot 4 and swipe 3 fingers DOWN.
• Paste text: Hold dot 4 and swipe 3 fingers to the RIGHT.

• Open options context menu: Swipe 3 fingers UP.
• Hide Braille keyboard: Swipe 2 fingers DOWN.
• Switch to next input method (e.g. Gboard): Swipe 3 fingers DOWN.
• Submit / Action (Send): Swipe 2 fingers UP.
